action_input.code:
import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Load superhero data
superheroes = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Get heroes with Super Strength (power_id=18) from the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute("SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = ?", (18,))
super_strength_hero_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
conn.close()

# Filter superheroes with Super Strength and height > 200cm
filtered = superheroes[
    (superheroes['id'].isin(super_strength_hero_ids)) & 
    (superheroes['height_cm'] > 200) &
    (superheroes['height_cm'].notna())
]

count = len(filtered)
print(f"Count of superheroes with Super Strength and height > 200cm: {count}")
print(f"\nMatching heroes:\n{filtered[['id', 'superhero_name', 'height_cm']]}")
